name: show_command
description: Show the person a command to run elsewhere (a terminal on another machine), as it is typed and easy to copy, under the label. Reply once the person says they ran it.

command.description: The command, exactly as it is typed

label.description: What running it does, e.g. Install the runner

submit.description: What the button saying it's done says, e.g. I've added it; I've run it when none

done.description: Whether the person says they did it; true unless they said otherwise
